verdict.rationale: Sill has no account and no server, and screen and input travel only between the user's own devices, so the whole product runs on hardware the user controls. The GitHub repo documents building Sill.app from source with SwiftPM and your own signing identity, rebinding the bundle identifier, and running the host headless with `swift run -c release SillHost`. Remote use goes through the user's own VPN or a forwarded port rather than a vendor relay. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license, independent hands-on corroboration of a self-built deployment.
